"""Authored in-memory peer calibration; no drawing file or CAD qualification."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import ezdxf
from ezdxf.audit import Auditor
from ezdxf.entities import Dictionary, VisualStyle
from ezdxf.lldxf.tags import Tags
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagwriter import TagCollector


def source(pairs):
    return "".join(f"{code}\n{value}\n" for code, value in pairs)


def export(entity):
    collector = TagCollector(dxfversion="AC1032")
    entity.export_dxf(collector)
    return [(tag.code, tag.value) for tag in collector.tags]


prefix = [(0, "VISUALSTYLE"), (5, "A1"), (330, "B1"),
          (100, "AcDbVisualStyle"), (2, "LOCAL_STYLE"), (70, 8),
          (73, 6), (421, 16777215), (291, 0)]
tail = [(70, 2), (62, 7), (420, 16777215), (176, 2),
        (90, 123456), (176, 1)]
rows = []
for label, payload in [
    ("two_property_tail", tail),
    ("wrong_declared_count", [(70, 3)] + tail[1:]),
    ("missing_last_companion", tail[:-1]),
]:
    style = VisualStyle.from_text(source(prefix + payload))
    emitted = export(style)
    actual = emitted[emitted.index((291, 0)) + 1:]
    assert actual == payload
    assert style.dxf.style_type == 8 and style.dxf.face_color_mode == 6
    rows.append(dict(case=label, tailPreserved=True, retainedTags=actual,
                     conclusion="opaque tail preservation, not property grammar validation"))

style = VisualStyle.from_text(source(prefix + tail))
clone = style.copy()
clone.acad_xdata.pop()
assert len(style.acad_xdata) == len(tail)
assert len(clone.acad_xdata) == len(tail) - 1
rows.append(dict(case="owned_tail_copy", sourceUnaffected=True))

dict_prefix = [(0, "DICTIONARY"), (5, "B1"), (330, "0"),
               (100, "AcDbDictionary"), (280, 0), (281, 1)]
for label, pairs, expected in [
    ("mixed_soft_then_hard", [(3, "A"), (350, "C1"), (3, "B"), (360, "C2")], 360),
    ("mixed_hard_then_soft", [(3, "A"), (360, "C1"), (3, "B"), (350, "C2")], 350),
    ("duplicate_key", [(3, "A"), (350, "C1"), (3, "A"), (350, "C2")], 350),
]:
    dictionary = Dictionary.from_text(source(dict_prefix + pairs))
    emitted = export(dictionary)
    edges = [(code, value) for code, value in emitted if code in (350, 360)]
    assert all(code == expected for code, _ in edges)
    if label == "duplicate_key":
        assert edges == [(350, "C2")]
    else:
        assert len(edges) == 2
    rows.append(dict(case=label, outputEdges=edges,
                     conclusion="diagnostic robustness input, not a valid mixed-edge format claim"))

doc = ezdxf.new("R2013")
dictionary = doc.rootdict.add_new_dict("LOCAL_DANGLING")
dictionary.load_dict(Tags.from_text(source([(3, "MISSING"), (350, "FFFF")])) )
before = list(dictionary.keys())
auditor = Auditor(doc)
dictionary.audit(auditor)
after = list(dictionary.keys())
assert before == ["MISSING"] and after == []
assert len(auditor.errors) == 0 and len(auditor.fixes) > 0
rows.append(dict(case="dangling_dictionary_audit", before=before, after=after,
                 errors=len(auditor.errors), fixes=len(auditor.fixes),
                 conclusion="zero errors after repair is not lossless graph evidence"))

modules = {}
for cls in [Dictionary, VisualStyle, Auditor, TagCollector]:
    import inspect
    path = Path(inspect.getfile(cls))
    modules[str(path)] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(dict(schema="libdxfrw-peer-component-calibration-v1",
                      version=ezdxf.__version__, cExtensions=ezdxf.options.use_c_ext,
                      qualificationEligible=False, rows=rows,
                      modules=modules,
                      recipe=Path(__file__).read_text()), indent=2))

"""Convert one tracked project-authored input; inspect literal tags before load."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/dli/dev/libdxfrw/tools")
from bounded_process import run_bounded

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
binary = Path("/Applications/ODAFileConverter.app/Contents/MacOS/ODAFileConverter")
rows = []
for year in (2018, 2013, 2010):
    out = root / f"oda-{year}"
    argv = [str(binary), str(root / "oda-input"), str(out), f"ACAD{year}",
            "DXF", "0", "0", "rtext_arctext.dwg"]
    process = run_bounded(argv, timeout=20, output_limit=65536)
    output = out / "rtext_arctext.dxf"
    row = dict(year=year, argv=argv, returncode=process.returncode,
               stdout=process.stdout.decode("utf8", "replace"),
               stderr=process.stderr.decode("utf8", "replace"),
               outputExists=output.is_file())
    rows.append(row)
    if process.returncode != 0 or not output.is_file():
        continue
    data = output.read_bytes()
    lines = data.decode("utf8").splitlines()
    assert len(lines) % 2 == 0
    pairs = [(int(lines[i]), lines[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(lines), 2)]
    records = []
    current = []
    for pair in pairs:
        if pair[0] == 0:
            if current and current[0] == (0, "VISUALSTYLE"):
                records.append(current)
            current = [pair]
        else:
            current.append(pair)
    styles = []
    for record in records:
        handle = next(value for code, value in record if code == 5)
        desc = next(value for code, value in record if code == 2)
        index = next(i for i, pair in enumerate(record) if pair[0] == 291)
        suffix = record[index + 1:]
        companions = [int(value) for code, value in suffix if code == 176]
        styles.append(dict(handle=handle, description=desc,
                           suffixTagCount=len(suffix), companionCount=len(companions),
                           companionValues=sorted(set(companions)),
                           companionsSha256=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(companions).encode()).hexdigest(),
                           propertyCount=[int(value) for code, value in suffix if code == 70]))
    row.update(outputSha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), outputBytes=len(data),
               styleCount=len(styles), styles=styles,
               flatLiteralRecord=next((record for record in records
                                       if (2, "Flat") in record), None))
    assert len(styles) == 24

print(json.dumps(dict(schema="libdxfrw-producer-conversion-calibration-v1",
                      qualificationEligible=False, auditRequested=False,
                      binary=str(binary), binarySha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      sourceSha256=hashlib.sha256((root / "oda-input/rtext_arctext.dwg").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      timeoutSeconds=20, perStreamOutputCap=65536, rows=rows,
                      recipe=Path(__file__).read_text())))

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
reports = []
for year in (2018, 2013, 2010):
    path = root / f"oda-{year}" / "rtext_arctext.dxf"
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    pairs = [(int(lines[i]), lines[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(lines), 2)]
    records = []
    current = []
    for pair in pairs:
        if pair[0] == 0:
            if current:
                records.append(current)
            current = [pair]
        else:
            current.append(pair)
    by_handle = {next(v.strip() for c, v in rec if c == 5): rec
                 for rec in records if any(c == 5 for c, v in rec)}
    flat = next(rec for rec in records if rec[0] == (0, "VISUALSTYLE")
                and (2, "Flat") in rec)
    xdict = None
    if (102, "{ACAD_XDICTIONARY") in flat:
        start = flat.index((102, "{ACAD_XDICTIONARY"))
        xdict = flat[start + 1][1].strip()
    dictionary = by_handle.get(xdict, [])
    targets = [v.strip() for c, v in dictionary if c in (350, 360)]
    reports.append(dict(year=year, outputSha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                        flatExtensionDictionary=xdict, dictionaryLiteral=dictionary,
                        targets=[dict(handle=target, literal=by_handle.get(target))
                                 for target in targets]))
print(json.dumps(dict(rows=reports, qualificationEligible=False,
                      recipe=Path(__file__).read_text())))

"""Handle-joined source-field/producer-tag crosswalk, not CAD semantic acceptance."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
peer_path = Path("/private/tmp/libdxfrw-broader-boundaries.eCaIDz/rtext_arctext-peer.json")
peer = json.loads(peer_path.read_text())
by_handle = {format(o["handle"][2], "X"): o for o in peer["OBJECTS"]
             if o.get("object") == "VISUALSTYLE"}
keys = ["face_lighting_model", "face_lighting_quality", "face_color_mode",
        "face_modifier", "face_opacity", "face_specular", "face_mono_color",
        "edge_model", "edge_style", "edge_intersection_color", "edge_obscured_color",
        "edge_obscured_ltype", "edge_intersection_ltype", "edge_crease_angle",
        "edge_modifier", "edge_color", "edge_opacity", "edge_width", "edge_overhang",
        "edge_jitter", "edge_silhouette_color", "edge_silhouette_width", "edge_halo_gap",
        "edge_isolines", "edge_do_hide_precision", "display_settings", "display_brightness",
        "display_shadow_type"]
keys += [f"b_prop{x:02x}" for x in range(0x1c, 0x25)]
keys += ["bl_prop25", "bd_prop26", "bd_prop27", "bl_prop28", "c_prop29", "bl_prop2a",
         "bl_prop2b", "c_prop2c", "b_prop2d", "bl_prop2e", "bl_prop2f", "bl_prop30",
         "b_prop31", "bl_prop32", "c_prop33", "bd_prop34", "edge_wiggle", "strokes",
         "b_prop37", "bd_prop38", "bd_prop39"]
assert len(keys) == 58 and len(by_handle) == 24
float_keys = {"face_opacity", "face_specular", "edge_crease_angle", "edge_opacity",
              "display_brightness"}
bool_keys = {"edge_do_hide_precision"}
colors = {"face_mono_color", "edge_intersection_color", "edge_obscured_color",
          "edge_color", "edge_silhouette_color", "c_prop29", "c_prop2c", "c_prop33"}
rows = []
for year in (2018, 2013, 2010):
    path = root / f"oda-{year}" / "rtext_arctext.dxf"
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    pairs = [(int(lines[i]), lines[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(lines), 2)]
    records, current = [], []
    for pair in pairs:
        if pair[0] == 0:
            if current and current[0] == (0, "VISUALSTYLE"):
                records.append(current)
            current = [pair]
        else:
            current.append(pair)
    counts = dict(styles=0, companions=0, nonColorValues=0, modernColors=0)
    methods, lighting_changes = {}, []
    for record in records:
        handle = next(v.strip() for c, v in record if c == 5)
        source = by_handle[handle]
        tail = record[next(i for i, (c, v) in enumerate(record) if c == 291) + 1:]
        if year >= 2013:
            assert tail.pop(0) == (70, "    58")
        groups, group = [], []
        for code, value in tail:
            if code == 176:
                groups.append((group, int(value)))
                group = []
            else:
                group.append((code, value))
        assert not group and len(groups) == (58 if year >= 2013 else 28)
        for key, (values, companion) in zip(keys, groups):
            assert companion == source.get(key + "_int", 0), (year, handle, key)
            counts["companions"] += 1
            if key in colors:
                if year < 2013:
                    continue
                raw = int(source[key]["rgb"], 16)
                method = raw >> 24
                methods[str(method)] = methods.get(str(method), 0) + 1
                assert values[0][0] == 62
                index = int(values[0][1])
                if method == 0xc2:
                    assert [(c, int(v)) for c, v in values if c == 420] == [(420, raw & 0xffffff)]
                elif method == 0xc3:
                    assert index == raw & 0xff
                elif method == 0xc8:
                    assert index == 257
                elif method == 0xc0:
                    assert index == 256
                elif method == 0xc1:
                    assert index == 0
                else:
                    raise AssertionError((handle, key, method))
                counts["modernColors"] += 1
                continue
            assert len(values) == 1, (year, handle, key, values)
            code, value = values[0]
            if key == "strokes":
                parsed, expected_code = value, 1
            elif key in float_keys or key.startswith("bd_prop"):
                parsed, expected_code = float(value), 40
            elif key in bool_keys or key.startswith("b_prop"):
                parsed, expected_code = int(value), 290
            else:
                parsed, expected_code = int(value), 90
            assert parsed == source[key], (year, handle, key, parsed, source[key])
            if year >= 2013:
                assert code == expected_code
            counts["nonColorValues"] += 1
        counts["styles"] += 1
        lighting = int(next(v for c, v in record if c == 177))
        if lighting != source["ext_lighting_model"]:
            lighting_changes.append(dict(handle=handle, source=source["ext_lighting_model"], target=lighting))
    assert counts["styles"] == 24
    rows.append(dict(year=year, counts=counts, colorMethods=methods,
                     lightingChanges=lighting_changes,
                     outputSha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
print(json.dumps(dict(rows=rows, qualificationEligible=False,
                      sourcePeerSha256=hashlib.sha256(peer_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      recipe=Path(__file__).read_text())))
